_method: Per-task protocol, calibrated against the paper's FullKV control row ONLY (never a LOCKS cell). Selection rule: (1) ELIGIBILITY — the arm's generations must be well-formed: no official-scorer exceptions, and answers must not be truncated at the token cap. (2) Among eligible arms, pick the one nearest the paper's FullKV value. If only one arm is eligible it wins regardless of distance.

_arms.A: prompt_model=chatglm3 (yarn_mistral completion templates), no chat template, reference generation budget
_arms.D: prompt_model=gpt4 (instruction templates) + GLM-4 chat template, generation budget = reference + gen_extra
